entities.summary: Raymond Wong Ying-wah is a Hong Kong film score composer. Among his works is the score for the 2004 martial arts film directed by Stephen Chow, Kung Fu Hustle, which was nominated for the Best Original Film Score in the 24th Hong Kong Film Awards. He also received nominations in the Hong Kong Film Awards for his score to Chow's 2001 film Shaolin Soccer, and for the 1995 Tsui Hark film Love in the Time of Twilight.
